task.title: P6-044: Build reverse paging (Previous) for /my and /catalog
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 5 — Missing capability). Original id: P6-044. Size: M. Specs: specs/app-ui.md, specs/collection-api.md, specs/catalog-search.md.

**Reverse paging (Previous) is unbuilt on both paged surfaces** — `/my` and `/catalog`, forward-only for the same structural reason (a keyset cursor means "everything after this row", so Previous needs a reverse-ordered query plus a `before` cursor); the `Pager` doc comment says so itself. Browser Back covers a session that walked forward, but a deep-linked cursored page has no way back except the start. Build it once and share it.
